name: conductor
description: Run a premium model (e.g. Claude Opus) as the planner and reviewer, and hand the reading, editing, building and testing to cheaper Gemini subagents so premium quota lasts longer.
suggestedPrompts: /conductor Build this feature end to end and keep my Opus usage low.

/conductor Review what the last worker changed and tell me if it's safe to ship.
